quiz.question_id: Apa itu interface composition di Go?
quiz.question_en: What is interface composition in Go?
options_id: Mendefinisikan interface baru yang meng-embed satu atau lebih interface lain
options_en: Defining a new interface that embeds one or more other interfaces
Creating an instance from an interface

quiz.question_id: Mengapa interface kecil lebih disukai di Go?
quiz.question_en: Why are small interfaces preferred in Go?
options_id: Karena Go tidak mendukung interface dengan banyak method
Karena lebih mudah diimplementasikan, di-mock, dan di-compose
Karena compiler Go hanya bisa menangani interface kecil
options_en: Because Go doesn't support interfaces with many methods
Because they are easier to implement, mock, and compose
Because they are faster at runtime
Because the Go compiler can only handle small interfaces
